================================================================================
Default mutable unified capture
================================================================================
fn owned() unified {mut}:
    pass
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(module (function_definition name: (identifier) parameters: (parameters) (unified_clause) body: (block (pass_statement))))

================================================================================
Exact parameter directive before a for loop
================================================================================
fn owned():
    @parameter
    for i in range(4):
        use(i)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(module (function_definition name: (identifier) parameters: (parameters) body: (block (parameter_for_statement (for_statement left: (identifier) right: (call function: (identifier) arguments: (argument_list (integer))) body: (block (call function: (identifier) arguments: (argument_list (identifier)))))))))

================================================================================
Parameter function decorator remains distinct from a parameter loop
================================================================================
fn owned():
    @parameter
    fn nested():
        pass
    @parameter
    for i in range(4):
        nested()
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(module (function_definition name: (identifier) parameters: (parameters) body: (block (decorated_definition (decorator (identifier)) definition: (function_definition name: (identifier) parameters: (parameters) body: (block (pass_statement)))) (parameter_for_statement (for_statement left: (identifier) right: (call function: (identifier) arguments: (argument_list (integer))) body: (block (call function: (identifier) arguments: (argument_list))))))))

================================================================================
Parameter remains an ordinary function and argument name
================================================================================
fn parameter(parameter: Int) -> Int:
    return parameter
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(module (function_definition name: (identifier) parameters: (parameters (typed_parameter (identifier) type: (type (identifier)))) return_type: (type (identifier)) body: (block (return_statement (identifier)))))
